slot_scores.name: single_vehicle_per_customer
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single truck visit the same customer more than once (e.g., split service across multiple stops), or must each customer be served exactly once by exactly one truck?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether a customer can be split across multiple stops/vehicles or must be served exactly once by one truck, matching the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: depot_return_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do all trucks have to start at the depot and return to the depot after finishing their route, or is it acceptable for a truck to end its route at the last customer it serves?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether trucks must return to the depot or can end at the last customer, matching the hidden slot.
